subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session-catalog plugins permanently advertise core new-session targets as a model plus optional required runtime, with the gateway validating the default agent and the UI locking catalog drafts to that agent?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but this choice defines a new plugin and gateway protocol contract plus the multi-agent behavior exposed to users; tests cannot determine the intended permanent product policy.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Keep the current generic capability, explicitly confirm the default-agent-only eligibility rule, document its semantics, and refresh the branch before landing.

options.title: Redesign creation ownership
options.body: Replace the advertised model contract with a dedicated server-side creation callback or RPC if catalog plugins should own agent selection and creation-time validation.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave catalog creation unsupported until a broader provider-native session and multi-agent policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current generic capability, explicitly confirm the default-agent-only eligibility rule, document its semantics, and refresh the branch before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans core gateway protocol, plugin API stability, session ownership, and Control UI product behavior.
